structuralBlockers.statement: Device-runtime evidence cannot be bound to the frozen seeded APK. The validator function validBuildBinding in scripts/audit/audits/a10.mjs requires the record apkSha256 to equal one of the two reproducible build captures recorded in the approved A9-BUILD-COMPARISON.json. Both captures are d79eb9253239352954c82322c0c46bdf17b00837b57a7a89d915272f69cbb32b. The frozen seeded APK f7f18ea3e3a0bd1b42b7b390e567993ad46160e0aa844a126509c28a33754287 is not among them, because it is produced by scripts/build-seeded-apk.mjs rather than by the audited npm run build:apk command. Any device record naming the seeded APK therefore returns DEVICE_RUNTIME_APK_BINDING_INVALID on any hardware.
structuralBlockers.consequence: The written instruction to bind every Phase 4C.2 result to f7f18ea3 is correct for owner-judgment gates but is not satisfiable for A10-04 and A10-05.

evidence.note: first.sha256 and second.sha256 both equal d79eb925; identityBound, toolchainMatch and normalizedEqual are all true

structuralBlockers.statement: No committed producer emits the required SAAGAR_A10_DEVICE_RUNTIME_ACCEPTANCE record. The record path prefix verification/audit/accepted/device-runtime/ does not exist in the working tree. The format appears only in the validator scripts/audit/audits/a10.mjs, in scripts/audit/evidence-trust-root.mjs, and in runner test fixtures. A valid record additionally requires an Ed25519 attestation signature from trusted signer keyId phase4a-renderer-ed25519-9ec3b61bbbdb245f and a SAAGAR_A10_DEVICE_HARNESS instrumentation artifact with its own artifact and protocol hashes.
structuralBlockers.consequence: Closing A10-04 or A10-05 requires building and signing a device harness. That is engineering work against a frozen product and is barred by the current freeze.
